findings.conclusion: 11th-edition Core Rules are publicly available from Games Workshop. The repository core-rules gap is an ingestion/registration gap, not a source-availability blocker.
findings.normative_use: Eligible for copyright-safe official semantic fingerprint/structured ingestion.

findings.conclusion: Faction Packs consolidate supplemental faction rules and clarifications: extra Detachments, datasheets, FAQs and errata. They supplement Codex content; MFM, core rules updates and other products remain separate.
findings.normative_use: Eligible for public official supplement/FAQ semantic ingestion, but not sufficient by itself to prove full Codex/app faction equivalence.

findings.conclusion: Games Workshop states the updated app integrates the new edition rules and exposes army rules/datasheets during play.
findings.normative_use: Confirms the app is a normative projection surface; does not grant repository access to app-only wording.

findings.conclusion: Games Workshop states rules updates are also made available in the Warhammer 40,000 app.
findings.normative_use: App wording/currentness remains an authorized-access evidence gap until directly captured and versioned.
